snippet.title: AstraCube: Building a Ship and Leaving a Cube Planet
snippet.description:
In AstraCube every planet is a cube. You crash on one with a broken ship, and getting it flying again is up to you. Here’s a ship being built and taking off, all real gameplay.

AstraCube is now in OPEN ALPHA. It’s free on Windows and Linux, and you get your access code as soon as you sign up:
🚀 https://playastracube.com

What’s in the game:
• Every world is a cube, and you can walk over the edge
• Mine, craft and build, from stone tools to power and machines
• Build your own ships and fly between the planets of your solar system
• Villages of six different races who talk, work and trade
• Play alone or co-op with friends

Join the community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/BnHfdKyTFy
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/AstraCube/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/playastracube.com
X: https://x.com/AstraCube_Dev
